author: Telos I
title: Telos I - Final Validation: LSS + DAQB + UMAP
abstract: This is the final validation of my "Latent Space Batch Standardization" (LSS) component within the SOTA architecture. It runs the full SOTA pipeline (`log1p -> scale -> PCA -> CORRECTION -> DAQB -> UMAP`), with LSS replacing the standard PBVE-lite correction. This provides a true apples-to-apples comparison to determine if LSS offers a synergistic improvement over the established SOTA baseline.
